title: PolishClans
description: A complete and intuitive Clan System for your Minecraft server, featuring alliance management, custom tags, and full PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
🛡️ Clan System – Advanced Clan Management
Bring advanced competition to your server with our powerful Clan System. This plugin offers an intuitive command set that allows for easy management of groups, alliances, and PvP dynamics.

📜 Commands
Below is the list of available commands:

/zaloz  – Create your own clan.

/usun – Delete the clan you lead.

/panel – Open the interactive clan management menu.

/opusc – Leave your current clan.

/zapros  – Invite a new member to the clan.

/dolacz  – Join a specific clan.

/gracz  – Check detailed information about a player.

/info  – View statistics and information about a clan.

/przenies  – Transfer leadership rights to another member.

/lider  – Promote or demote a player to deputy leader status.

/wyrzuc  – Remove a player from the clan.

/ustawpvp – Enable or disable friendly fire within the clan.

/sojusz  – Send an alliance request to another clan.

/rozwiaz  – Break an existing alliance.

🌐 PlaceholderAPI Integration
The plugin fully supports PlaceholderAPI, allowing you to display a player's clan tag in chat, tablists, or scoreboards.

Placeholder: %klan%

Note: To use this feature, the PlaceholderAPI plugin must be installed on your server.
